WorkflowCoach is NovaLearn AI's upcoming guided workflow assistant that moves the platform from passive Q&A to active, step-by-step coaching through complex procedures [NL-002-S07, NL-015-S05]. It is currently in a restricted private beta enabled for approximately 11% of active customers, primarily mid-market logistics and enterprise manufacturing clients such as Acme Manufacturing [NL-002-S07, NL-014-S05, NL-001-S03]. During this phase, high-volume floor-level testing has surfaced needs for offline caching of step lists and automated photo verification of physical tasks [NL-014-S05].

Planned core capabilities include ingesting procedural documents (checklists, regulatory manuals, safety SOPs) from KnowledgeHub, parsing them into sequential operational blocks, guiding employees step-by-step, and requiring confirmations such as checkboxes, regex-validated text entry, or OCR-verified photo uploads before unlocking the next step [NL-002-S07, NL-014-S03]. Each completed step is recorded with timestamp, user ID, and input payload in a write-once PostgreSQL compliance log; skipped safety steps or failed validations flag the session and notify the shift supervisor [NL-002-S07, NL-014-S03].

Officially, the public beta target is September 2026, available to all active Growth and Enterprise accounts, with the v2.9.0 release dated September 29, 2026 [NL-014-S05, NL-014-S03, NL-002-S07]. The public release depends on the Advanced OCR Pipeline (v2.8.0, August 2026) and the Okta permission synchronization engine [NL-014-S05, NL-002-S07].

Informal internal sources indicate significant timeline risk. The CTO reports the September target is in serious jeopardy due to state-management latency (up to 4 seconds during step transitions) and permission-inheritance failures, with a realistic engineering estimate of November 2026 [NL-015-S05]. Internally, there are discussions about offering a simplified, single-workspace private beta in September for non-regulated customers with flat document structures, while deferring the full cross-workspace permission-sync version to the November public release [NL-015-S05, NL-015-S08]. Action items include drafting a contingency timeline, defining the September private beta cohort, and detailing features deferred to November such as cross-workspace permission synchronization [NL-015-S09].

Currently, the official external messaging retains the September 2026 public beta target, but internal leadership is aligning on a November slip contingency plan; the evidence does not show an official public revision of the date [NL-015-S05].
